content_record.title: Targeting senescence: the new precision arsenal against aging
content_record.editorial_body: A systematic review maps senolytics, senomorphics, and metabolic mimetics—plus AI-driven discovery—to redefine healthspan. Senolytics like dasatinib + quercetin clear senescent cells. Senomorphics such as rapamycin suppress the SASP phenotype. Caloric restriction mimetics boost autophagy and mitochondrial function. This signal is based on Insights into the therapeutic strategies for aging and aging-associated diseases. from PubMed. Read the original report for full context.
